extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: narrow-body passenger jet airliner, approx. 38.2 x 35.3 x 12.3 m (L x wingspan x H), fuselage diameter 4.0 m
extras.notes: nose faces -Y; stands on its tricycle landing gear (z = 0 = tire bottoms); 6 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); twin-engine turbofan, low wing with sharklets; opaque tinted windows, no interior; neutral paint (white, light grey belly, sky-blue accents), no airline livery, no logo, no text, no registration

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
